standard-dialogue.npc: I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.

steps.npc: Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!

steps.player: Were you paid to say that?

steps.npc: Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.

steps.text: If the player does not have an Al kharid flyer:

steps.npc: Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?

steps.text: If the player already has an Al kharid flyer:

steps.npc: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!

steps.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.npc: I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.

options.text: What is there to do round here, boy?

steps.player: What is there to do round here, boy?

steps.npc: I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.

standard-dialogue-using-an-al-kharid-lea.player: I don't want this! It's out of date!

standard-dialogue-using-an-al-kharid-lea.npc: Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
